install:
sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update
sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y python3.12-venv python3.12-dev
cd backend
python3 -m venv venv
./venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip
./venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
./venv/bin/pip install ruff pytest pytest-asyncio httpx
cd ../frontend
npm ci
start:
if curl -sf --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:8000/health >/dev/null; then echo 'backend already running'; exit 0; fi
cd /workspace/backend
nohup ./venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 >/tmp/setuphelfer-backend.log 2>&1 &
for i in $(seq 1 90); do curl -sf --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:8000/health && exit 0; sleep 1; done
echo 'backend failed to become ready'; tail -n 80 /tmp/setuphelfer-backend.log || true
exit 1
